title: Quantum experiments suggest the world is mental

statements.text: Recent tests of Bell and Leggett inequalities and of contextuality suggest that physical properties do not exist before observation, which fits the hypothesis that the world is mental in nature.

sources.locator: Appendix A (reprint of Humanities 6(3), article 55, 2017), abstract
sources.quote: But a consistent series of recent experimental results suggests strongly that the world may in fact be mental in nature, a hypothesis openly discussed in the field of foundations of physics.
